Name: Farm Extended by Forkmaster (Unofficial 1.6 Update)
Author: welterusten
Description:
[b][font=Arial][size=5][center]A united Farm Map that allows foraging, mining and fishing![/center][/size][/font][size=2]
[size=3]Features[/size][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Dedicated animal area
[*]Dedicated mining area
[*]Daily renewable hardwood stumps
[*]Water trough so no random ponds obstruct your farm land
[*]Crossmap warps via the minecarts and boats
[*]One-way access to the minecart network once restored via the ticket machine
[/list][b]
[size=3]1.6 Overhaul for Forkmaster's Farm Extended Map.[/size]
[/b]Uploaded with permission from Forkmaster. Will take this mod down if and when they return to modding.
Fixes various things related to moving initial farm buildings like the farm house and greenhouse.
Removed Farm Type Manager dependency since spawning forage and spawning minerals is now possible via map properties.
[b]
[size=3]Installation
[/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip the contents into your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_mods][i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i][/url]﻿ folder
[/list]
[b][size=3]Compatibility[/size]
[/b]Tested on Single Player Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux.
Works on Multiplayer as tested by bsdsb
[i][size=3]Compatible with:[/size]
[/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15041]Secret Woods Extra Area[/url] by tikamin557as of v1.1.0
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] by FlashShifter as of v1.4.0 [size=2][i](looking for more feedback)[/i][/size]
[i][size=3]
Incompatible with:[/size][/i]
[list]
[*]Anything that overwrites the same selected Farm Map
[*]Probably anything that edits the Secret Woods [s](but are they really secret at this point)[/s]
[*]Most likely incompatible with existing save files. Best to start a new save file.
[/list]I can try to add compatibility for the second point.[b]


Credits:
[/b][list]
[*]Forkmaster for the original Farm Extended Map
[*]FlashShifter for Stardew Valley Expanded and relevant Map Patch
[/list]
